The '''TIE Advanced prototype''' was an [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|advanced prototype]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], forerunner to the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]]. It was built, in a limited number, by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] in the years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The few ships built were gifted to members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] or other favored [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The prototype had a sleeker design and thus a smaller silhouette than its eventual successor, because it featured a more compact wing panel configuration.

==Behind the scenes==
===Continuity===
Publisher [[becker&mayer!]] has confirmed that the Imperial Handbook is branded as ''Star Wars'' Legends despite ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' being produced after April 2014's split of the [[Canon]]/[[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuities. The description of the TIE Advanced prototype matches that of the [[TIE/ad v1]], even though the latter was designated under Canon. <!-- This article assumes that this content falling under the Legends continuity is not an error. -->
